'''Tandis Four''' was a planet<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|216|Tandis Four}}</ref> in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji" /> It was the location of the [[Museum of Light]], which on [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] orders was destroyed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], prior to the conclusion of the [[Battle of Drongar|struggle]] for control of [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].<ref name="JH" /> This attack hurt [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] morale in the region, and [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] considered it the greatest tragedy of the Clone Wars, and a heathen act on behalf of Dooku.<ref name="Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji" />
